headline: US nuclear startup to explore plants in PH
summary: Aalo Atomics is considering the Philippines for its first out-of-country site and signed an MoU with SKAFF Group. Plants could be installed as early as 2031.
why: Small modular nuclear reactors are a developing part of the power-supply pipeline, and first international deployments signal future demand. Startups in this area depend heavily on private financing and regulatory approvals.
